description:
Discover this 66± acre ranch for sale in Falls County, Texas, featuring scenic creek frontage, multiple potential homesites, and excellent recreational opportunities. Whether you're looking to build your dream home, enjoy a weekend retreat, or invest in Texas land, this versatile property offers the perfect blend of natural beauty and functionality.

With attractive frontage along Deer Creek, this ranch provides a picturesque setting complemented by multiple scenic homesites. A water meter is already in place, electric lines run across the property, and abundant native wildlife make this an excellent choice for hunting, recreation, or country living. Plus, additional acreage is available for those looking to expand their investment.

Property Highlights

• 66± Acres in Falls County, Texas
• Scenic Deer Creek Frontage
• Water Meter in Place
• Electric Line Across the Property
• Multiple Beautiful Homesites
• Abundant Whitetail Deer and Native Wildlife
• Excellent Hunting and Recreational Opportunities
• Additional Acreage Available

Whether you're searching for Falls County land for sale, Texas acreage with creek frontage, hunting land, recreational property, or a future homesite in Central Texas, this ranch offers outstanding potential.
